title: Existence of K-injective resolutions
statement:
Every complex in $\mathsf{Cpx}(\Mod(T_{\Et},R))$ admits a K-injective
resolution $K\to I$, functorially up to chain homotopy; two K-injective
resolutions of one object are chain-homotopy equivalent, and a bounded-below
complex of injective objects is K-injective.

proof.text: For the Grothendieck category of étale module sheaves, the existing functorial replacement declarations `CochainComplex.kInjectiveResolutionFunctor`, `toKInjectiveResolution`, and `monoQuasiIso_toKInjectiveResolution_app` provide the resolution object and quasi-isomorphism; `isKInjective_kInjectiveResolutionFunctor_obj` provides K-injectivity. Functoriality gives identity and composition homotopies, while naturality of the augmentation gives the final compatibility.

source.place: Injectives, Theorem 079P (label theorem-K-injective-embedding-grothendieck), specialized to the module-sheaf category of Modules on Sites, Lemmas 03DA, 03DB, 03EW

proof.text: For two resolutions, the proof uses the existing derived-category K-injective bijection (`IsKInjective.Qh_map_bijective`) to lift the comparison and its inverse. Injectivity identifies their composites and the two augmentation composites, yielding the required `HomotopyEquiv`.

source.place: Derived Categories, Lemma 070I (label lemma-K-injective), morphisms into a K-injective complex computed in the homotopy category; the inverse-isomorphism argument is written here

proof.text: The last conjunct is exactly Mathlib’s `CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective` after supplying the strict lower bound and injectivity hypotheses.

source.place: Derived Categories, Section 070G (label section-K-injective), bounded-below complexes of injectives; Mathlib/Algebra/Homology/HomotopyCategory/KInjective.lean, isKInjective_of_injective, line 133

lean.statement: theorem etale_kinjective_resolutions_exist (T : Scheme.{u}) (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] : (∃ (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) ℤ → CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) ℤ) (s : ∀ K, K ⟶ I K) (φ : ∀ {K L}, (K ⟶ L) → (I K ⟶ I L)), (∀ K, IsKInjectiveResolution T R (s K)) ∧ (∀ K, Nonempty (Homotopy (φ (𝟙 K)) (𝟙 (I K)))) ∧ (∀ {K L M} (f : K ⟶ L) (g : L ⟶ M), Nonempty (Homotopy (φ (f ≫ g)) (φ f ≫ φ g))) ∧ (∀ {K L} (f g : K ⟶ L), Nonempty (Homotopy f g) → Nonempty (Homotopy (φ f) (φ g))) ∧ (∀ {K L} (f : K ⟶ L), Nonempty (Homotopy (s K ≫ φ f) (f ≫ s L)))) ∧ (∀ (K I J : CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) ℤ) (s : K ⟶ I) (t : K ⟶ J), IsKInjectiveResolution T R s → IsKInjectiveResolution T R t → Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv I J)) ∧ (∀ (I : CochainComplex (Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R)) ℤ) (d : ℤ), I.IsStrictlyGE d → (∀ n : ℤ, Injective (I.X n)) → I.IsKInjective)
